notes.title: 6/19 Version 1.4.3 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195535/0a10c636e0184b052591b312d14294affc5df9d3.png

Dear Mahjong Players,

A new update for Amatsuki Mahjong (Version 1.4.3) was released on June 19 (Thur). This update includes system adjustments and fixes for several known issues.

This update does not require server maintenance and is non-mandatory. However, we still recommend updating to the latest version via your app store to enjoy the most complete gameplay experience.

[Version 1.4.3 Update Details]



1. Fixed an issue when viewing statistics for 3-player Japanese Mahjong, data from 4-player Japanese Mahjong is incorrectly displayed. 

2. Fixed an issue in Sichuan Mahjong replay records, the detailed view of each round incorrectly shows [Draw Game]. After the fix, it will only display the point gained by the player in that round.

3. Fixed an issue when watching Sichuan Mahjong replays, manually skipping through turns may cause the playback to freeze and stop progressing.

4. Fixed an issue when viewing Hong Kong Mahjong replays, there is a chance the playback may freeze and become unable to proceed.

5. Adjusted certain character animations and gestures for improved visuals.

6. Resolved visual display issues in Pinball Playground where pinballs appeared to disappear, be launched multiple times, or vouchers seemed to be deducted incorrectly. (Note: The reward judgment was completed correctly, and no tickets were actually deducted.)

The Amatsuki Mahjong Operations Team

notes.title: 02/11 Maintenance Completion Announcement [1.3.6 Update]
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195535/3456ad04a9a453c08426522460e12e31e28e9492.png

Dear Mahjong Players,

The scheduled maintenance for Amatsuki Mahjong on February 11 (Tuesday) has been successfully completed! The Lantern Festival update [Version 1.3.6] is now live, bringing new content and features.

Please download the latest update from your respective platform to experience the new content and continue your mahjong journey!
PC, iOS, Android Download: https://amatsukimj.onelink.me/nzNm/ofSNS


[New Content]

1. 

Event Period: After maintenance on February 11 ~ March 4, 03:59 (UTC+8)

Event Details:
Complete event tasks to earn chances to light up Sky Lanterns and claim rewards, including:
Fatebind Vouchers, Moonstones, Event-Limited Avatar Frame, Event-Limited Title, Fatebind Gifts, Coins, and more!

Additionally, there are new Fatebind gifts have been introduced! Light up the corresponding Sky Lantern to unlock exclusive Lantern Festival story dialogues and interact with our new character, Xiao Qing!
(For full event details, please check the event page.)


2. 
Availability: After maintenance on February 11 ~ March 4, 03:59 (UTC+8)

The Lantern Festival Exclusive Character, Xiao Qing (CV: Yui Ogura), has arrived in the limited-time Fatebind pool  [Luminous Jade]! This is the only opportunity to fatebind with her! Don’t miss your chance to meet the Incarnation of the Green Serpent!

[previewyoutube=YV2xxbYQ-9k;full][/previewyoutube]

3. 

Availability: After maintenance on February 11 ~ March 4, 03:59 (UTC+8)

The permanent pool character, Koi Chiyo (CV: Hinano Harumi [JP] /  Marika [CN] / MK Mui [Cantonese]), is featured in the limited-time Fatebind pool [ Fated Omen] with increased drop rates! This is your best chance to fatebind with the Miko of Rice Pot Shrine!


4. 

New Awakening Costumes for Xiao Qing and Koi Chiyo have been added!

Duplicate Fatebinds grant Character Fragments, which can be used for Awakening.
Reach Awakening Level 5 to unlock their exclusive Awakening Costumes!


5. 

Availability: After maintenance on February 11 ~ March 4, 03:59 (UTC+8)

Xiao Qing’s Lantern Festival-themed outfit and accessories bundle are now available for a limited time! The bundle includes: [Lantern-lit Serenade] costume, [Eternal Lantern] Table Cloth, and [Emerald Serpent] Riichi Stick. Unlock them now and spend a wonderful Lantern Festival evening with Xiao Qing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45195535/fc377ba09b756e324bd66994fa75796ff9277579.png

6. 

[Free Moonstone Chest] – Claim once per day for a chance to receive 10~720 Moonstones.

[Lucky Moonstone Chest] – Purchase once per day for 60 Diamonds, with a chance to obtain 60~1000 Moonstones.

Other New Bundles:

Permanent Bundles:
[Beginner’s Must-Buy Bundle], [Beginner’s Accessories Bundle]

Limited-Time Lantern Festival Bundles:
[Moonlit Fatebind Bundle], [Affection Growth Bundle], [Deluxe Fatebind Bundle]

Availability: After maintenance on February 11 ~ March 4, 03:59 (UTC+8)


7. 

Players can now review match records and replays for Hong Kong and Taiwan Mahjong modes via the Hand Records feature!

[Fixes & Improvements]



1. Mobile performance optimization
2. Improved reconnection during matches
3. Lowered entry fees and entry requirement for all Mahjong modes
4. Removed ""Hide Personal Info"" feature
5. Fixed an issue where players got stuck in a queue after a friend match ended
6. Corrected some text wording
7. Fixed an issue where the batch recycle page did not close properly
8. Fixed an issue where the server switch button was unresponsive in certain situations
9. Optimized Fatebind descriptions (drop rates and contents remain unchanged).




1. [Japanese Mahjong] Fixed a bug where the Riichi indicator blocked button interactions.
2. [Taiwan Mahjong] Reduced the negative score coefficient for ranking points (PT) calculation.
3. [Hong Kong Mahjong] Fixed an issue where some waiting hand (tenpai) point values displayed incorrectly.
4. [Taiwan & Hong Kong Mahjong] Fixed a bug where North Wind dealer continuation was unavailable in North rounds.

The Amatsuki Mahjong Operations Team

notes.title: 01/20 - 1.3.1 Version - Maintenance Completion
notes.notes:
Dear Mahjong Player,

Thank you for your enthusiastic support of Amatsuki Mahjong!

After verification, it was confirmed that the instability of the cloud server provider's service led to a certain probability of abnormal status when players enter the game. The game engineers have urgently replaced the connection line at 20:30 (UTC+8) on January 20 (Monday), and the situation has been largely rectified. Compensation has been sent for this maintenance, and all players can check it in the "Mail".

If you still continue to experience unstable login after re-login, please report your situation to customer service, and the operation team will make adjustments as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

As a token of gratitude for your patience and support during this emergency maintenance, we are offering the following compensation, which can be claimed via in-game mail after logging in:

Maintenance Compensation:
Fatebind Voucher x 5
Special Gift Box x 2

Thank you again for your support and understanding. May your games be filled with victory!

The Amatsuki Mahjong Operations Team
